description: This PHP source file defines the EducationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing Education records within an HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting education entries, utilizing services and models for data handling and validation.

classes.name: EducationAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing Education entities within the HRM system, supporting CRUD operations with validation and data transformation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Education record by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EducationService instance used to perform data operations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules ensuring the ID parameter is a positive integer.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Education records, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Education record from request data.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Common method to save either new or existing Education entities with provided data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating an Education record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Education record identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an Education record, including unique constraints.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' property, ensuring string type, max length, and uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple Education records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, ensuring IDs are an array of integers.
